question: How many Cricket World Cup titles has India Women won as of 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India Women clinched their first-ever ICC Women’s ODI Cricket World Cup title in 2025, defeating South Africa by 52 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• This was India’s **maiden ICC Women’s ODI World Cup win.**
 
• Final held at **DY Patil Stadium, Navi Mumbai.**
 
• India defeated South Africa by 52 runs.
 
• **Shafali Verma** was Player of the Match.
 
• **Deepti Sharma** was Player of the Series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Previous Best:** Runners-up in 2005 and 2017.
 
• **Coach:** Amol Muzumdar
 
• **Captain:** Harmanpreet Kaur
 
• **Venue:** Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
 
• **Year:** 2025
